subject: Inbound: Developer Summit - invite flows, persona mailflows & tracking matrix
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inbound: Developer Summit - invite flows, persona mailflows & tracking matrix

Team —

Drafting this thread to lock the invite sequence for Developer Summit (target send week of June 14). Goal: 1) get 800–1,000 targeted developer signups from product/infra teams, 2) collect early POCs for Dedicated trials. Need final decisions on: audience segmentation, two subject lines to A/B test, tracking tokens, and RSVP reminder cadence.

Attachments: persona_map.csv (seg lists), tracking_matrix_v4.xlsx (UTM + HubSpot workflow), invite_copy_v3.docx (3 email variants)

High level proposal: 
- Segments: Platform Engineers (high-priority), Product Managers (warm), Infra Architects (cold) — see persona_map.csv
- Sequence (per persona): Invite Day 0 -> Reminder Day 3 -> Last-call 48h -> Post-webinar thank-you
- Tracking: unique utm_campaign per persona + liquid token for subject personalization; final UTMs in tracking_matrix_v4.xlsx
- Send windows: Tue/Wed mornings (10am PT) for platform engineers.

Action items: 
- Marissa: finalize subject line A/B and HubSpot audience mappings by EOD Thu.
- Hannah: confirm reminder cadence and calendar links; propose SMS fallback for registered no-shows?
- Marcus: review tracking matrix and ensure Events API will ingest RSVP+attendance flags.

I've included a short invite copy variant below (Variant A) — please mark edits inline.

--- Invite Variant A (short) ---
Subject: Developer Summit — How to run LLM inference at scale, June 22
Hi {{first_name}},
We're hosting a short, tactical session for engineers who run inference in production. You'll walk away with practical configs for latency and cost.
When: Tue, June 22, 10:00am PT (30 minutes + live Q&A)
Register: [RSVP link]

Best,
Vivek
Head of Field Marketing
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700

Vivek — thanks, looks great. A few notes after reviewing the attachments: 

1) Subject line test ideas (Platform Engs):
   - A: "Developer Summit — run LLM inference at scale (30 min)"
   - B: "How top teams cut inference cost by 2x — live demo"

2) HubSpot segs: persona_map.csv maps to three lists I already have in HubSpot: "Prod-Infra-Platform-Eng", "Product-PM-Apps", "Infra-Architects-Event". I'll wire the campaign UTMs to those lists if Marcus confirms Events API will pass attendance.

3) Copy edits: remove the phrase "You're invited" from the opener — it's generic. Suggest pushing the tactical hook earlier ("short, tactical session for engineers who run inference in production"). Also add an optional line about recordings and slide deck for registrants.

4) For tracking_matrix_v4.xlsx: I propose adding a hubspot_workflow_id column so we can trigger nurture emails for no-shows.

Quick micro-question: are we planning to send an internal exec notification to AE + CSMs when someone registers from a named account? If yes, I can add a webhook in the workflow.

Marissa
Sr. Growth Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Inbound: Developer Summit - invite flows, persona mailflows & tracking matrix

All —

Thanks for the clear brief. A couple practical items on reminders and calendar flow: 

Reminder cadence (recommended):
- Confirmation email on register (immediate) — includes calendar add link and add-to-calendar ICS
- Reminder 1: 3 days before (email)
- Reminder 2: 1 day before (email + optional SMS if mobile number collected)
- Last-call: 2 hours before (email)

Calendar & RSVP handling: 
- Use a single RSVP link that sets utm params per persona and redirects to a personalized Thank-you page with calendar .ics. That page will ping Events API to mark "registered" and push HubSpot contact property "dev_summit_2027_registered":true.

A few asks: 
- Can Marcus confirm that our Events API can accept utm_source and utm_content fields? If not, we need to rely on the redirect landing page to capture them.
- For the SMS fallback: include an opt-in checkbox on the registration page. We can add a conditional HubSpot workflow to send SMS 1 hour prior for opt-ins.

Attachment: reminder_cadence_v1.txt (stub)

Hannah
Field Marketing Ops
Redwood Inference

Quick update — Events API confirmation and final matrix attached.

- Events API: accepts utm_campaign, utm_source, utm_medium, utm_content. We'll pass an extra field "campaign_persona" so downstream workflows can easily segment.
- I've added hubspot_workflow_id and a boolean column for notify_ae_on_named_account in tracking_matrix_v4.xlsx.
- Calendar flow: we'll generate the .ics per registration and include a tracking query param so attendance auto-ties back to the registration record.

Attached: tracking_matrix_v4.xlsx (final-for-send)

Next steps per owner: 
- Marissa: finalize subject lines + publish HubSpot campaign (target Thu EOD).
- Hannah: confirm SMS vendor opt-in copy and include it on the registration page (due Thu).
- Vivek: approve final invite_copy_v3.docx with the tactical hook and recording line.

I'm good on the Events API side — will monitor the webhook tests.

Marcus
Growth Analytics Engineer
Redwood Inference
